subject: Recap: CoastAI pilot spend band & PO threshold (next steps)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Li <alex.li@coastai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: CoastAI pilot spend band & PO threshold (next steps)

Hi Alexandra,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Wanted to summarize the key commercial points we discussed and confirm next steps so your procurement team can plan.

Quick recap of requirements you confirmed:
- Pilot scope: live inference for 3 internal apps (summarization + chat)
- Expected traffic: ~80M tokens/month peak, ~35M tokens/month baseline (first 3 months)
- Latency SLO: 150-250ms P95 for single-stream inference

Commercial notes we discussed:
- Target unit economics: you called out a target in the $10–$18 per 1M tokens range for the pilot (goal to validate ops & cost)
- Procurement trigger: you mentioned that purchases above $20k/month will require a formal PO and legal review; under that threshold procurement can accept a credit-card/chargeable invoice or simplified SOW

What I recommend (based on token volume + target unit economics):
- Proposed monthly spend band for pilot (pricing example): $3500–$9000 / month (maps to ~35M baseline @ ~$10/1M up to ~80M at discounted commitment tiers)
- Recommended purchase lane: start with a 3-month committed pilot at the lower band ($3.5k/mo) with an option to scale to a 50% commit increase if you hit the higher volume in month 2. This keeps initial procurement under the PO threshold and shortens legal lead time.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate-v1.xlsx (simple banded pricing + sample invoice cadence) and a mutual-action-plan PDF with milestones.

Questions / asks for you:
1) Can you confirm whether your procurement threshold is firm at $20k/month or if exceptions exist for pilots?
2) Please confirm the primary billing contact and required PO fields (billing email, billing address, tax ID, PO reference format).
3) Would you like us to model a 3-month commitment at the lower band vs. a month-to-month trial for internal finance?

If you confirm procurement constraints and billing contact, I’ll share an updated pricing estimate that aligns to the unit economics you called out and propose a timeline for PO vs. CC billing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
Attachment: coastai-mutual-action-plan.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
From: Alexandra Li <alex.li@coastai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@coastai.com
Date: 2026-10-06T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: CoastAI pilot spend band & PO threshold (next steps)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the clear recap — that mirrors our notes. A few clarifications from procurement side:
- Confirmed: anything over $20k/month will need a PO and will route to Legal for T&Cs. For pilots we can make exceptions up to $30k with a standard SOW, but exceptions >$30k are unlikely without exec sign-off.
- Billing contact: procurement@coastai.com (I’m copying them here). They will need: billing email, company billing address, and tax ID. We use a standard PO template — I’ll forward that shortly.

On volumes: the 35M baseline is what the product team expects initially; if early adoption goes faster we may hit 70–80M by month 2.

Request from our side: please send an updated estimate that shows 1) month-to-month cost at baseline, 2) a 3-month committed pilot price, and 3) an optional uplift band for 50% higher volume (so we can show the numbers to Finance). If you can include a row showing the $/1M tokens effective rate for each band that would be super helpful.

Also, I’ve attached our PO template (sent separately by procurement@coastai.com).

Thanks —
Alexandra
Head of Product | CoastAI
alex.li@coastai.com

---
Forwarded attachment: coastai-PO-template.docx (DOCX, 24KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Li <alex.li@coastai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T10:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: CoastAI pilot spend band & PO threshold (next steps)

Alexandra — thanks, got it. Looping Sean (Head of Sales) and Rishi (Commercial Ops) to align the ask and finalize the numbers.

Sean / Rishi — per Alexandra: baseline ~35M tokens/mo, likely ramp to 70–80M if early adoption. Procurement requires PO > $20k/mo (exceptions up to $30k with SOW).

I built a compact price model (attached: redwood-pricing-estimate-v2.xlsx) with three rows as requested:
- Month-to-month baseline (no commitment): list price $12 / 1M tokens => baseline ~ $420 / month at 35M (note: list price here is illustrative; actual per-1M pricing in sheet)
- 3-month committed pilot: effective $9 / 1M tokens at baseline => ~$315 / month (3-month billed monthly)
- Committed + uplift (50% volume): blended effective $7.5 / 1M tokens at the higher slab => shows savings if you move to a committed tier

Recommendation: to keep procurement simple and avoid PO delays, propose the 3-month committed pilot at the lower band that keeps initial monthly spend under the PO threshold. If the product team ramps early we can auto-escalate to the uplift tier and issue a short addendum (no new PO required for under $30k, per Alexandra).

Next actions I propose:
1) I’ll share the v2 estimate (attached) with procurement@coastai.com and request their PO template to populate with our billing info.
2) Sean / Rishi — can Legal approve the standard SOW template we use for pilots if procurement wants the SOW path? If so I’ll attach SOW and request signature.
3) Alexandra — please confirm which option you want Finance to review (month-to-month vs 3-month commit). Once you confirm I’ll convert the v2 spreadsheet to a formal quote and DocuSign-ready SOW.

Thanks all —
Vanessa

---
Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB)

Subject: Re: Recap: CoastAI pilot spend band & PO threshold (next steps)

Thanks Vanessa — looks sensible. A couple quick notes from Sales Ops / Legal perspective:
- Rishi: please pre-clear the standard pilot SOW (I’ve attached the usual template to the HubSpot deal). If no material changes we can route via DocuSign and avoid a lengthy legal review.
- Procurement threshold: we’ll offer the 3-month committed pilot priced to land under $20k/month in the initial configuration; if CoastAI requests the higher committed band (which could push near $25k/mo) we’ll require the PO template and a short T&C waiver.

Vanessa — please convert v2 to a formal quote and include the SOW as an attachment. Rishi and I will triage the HubSpot deal (COAST-2026-PILOT-47) and flag for expedited review if procurement returns the PO.
